commands.name: dungeon-doctor
commands.description: Diagnose dungeon room data including object counts, sprite limits, chest conflicts, and bounds checking.

commands.name: dungeon-get-palette
commands.description: Resolve a US/OOS room's full 8-bit palette-set ID to its shared global dungeon palette and report every affected room; other regional layouts fail closed

commands.name: dungeon-list-pot-items
commands.description: List existing pot items with raw positions and ROM addresses

commands.name: dungeon-object-validate
commands.description: Trace dungeon object draws and compare bounds to selection dimensions. JSON/CSV reports are only written when --report names a path.

commands.name: dungeon-oracle-preflight
commands.description: Run all Oracle ROM safety checks (water-fill region/table, custom collision maps, required-room collision) and emit one JSON report. Returns non-zero on any error.

commands.name: dungeon-place-object
commands.description: Place a dungeon object with immutable capacity/COW preflight (dry-run by default)

commands.name: dungeon-place-sprite
commands.description: Place a dungeon sprite (dry-run by default, --write to apply)

commands.name: dungeon-remove-object
commands.description: Remove one ordinary dungeon object with exact identity guards (dry-run by default)

commands.name: dungeon-remove-sprite
commands.description: Remove a dungeon sprite by index or exact coordinates

commands.name: dungeon-set-collision-tile
commands.description: Set one or more custom collision tiles in a dungeon room

commands.name: dungeon-set-door-type
commands.description: Change one existing door type with coordinate/CAS and manifest guards (dry-run by default)

commands.name: dungeon-set-palette-color
commands.description: Dry-run or persist one US/OOS shared dungeon palette color with palette-set/index/color CAS, manifest ownership, exact fence, clean-file baseline, required backup, atomic save, and external reopen guards

commands.name: dungeon-set-pot-item
commands.description: Change one existing pot item with index/position/item CAS and manifest guards (dry-run by default)

commands.name: dungeon-stream-plan
commands.description: Read-only stream inventory, alias/overlap, and free-space diagnostics; replacement-aware immutable move output is pending

commands.name: gfx-export
commands.description: Export a graphics sheet (or 16x16 block range) to an indexed PNG with a chosen palette.

commands.name: gfx-import
commands.description: Import an indexed PNG into a graphics sheet: preview the exact changes, then write a new ROM file.

commands.name: gfx-room-export
commands.description: Export a dungeon room's background sheets to one PNG with the room palette, and list the rooms that share them.

commands.name: gfx-room-import
commands.description: Import an edited room background PNG into the sheets it changes.

commands.name: gfx-sheet-inventory
commands.description: List graphics sheets with free 16x16 blocks, reserved sheets, and the blocksets, spritesets, areas and rooms that use them.

commands.name: gfx-tilemap-render
commands.description: Render a 2bpp menu tilemap file to an indexed PNG using real CHR and palette sources, for headless pixel comparisons.

commands.name: graphics-doctor
commands.description: Validate graphics sheets, compression, and palette references.

commands.name: hex-annotate
commands.description: Show known data structure annotations at a ROM offset.

commands.name: hex-compare
commands.description: Compare two ROM files byte-by-byte with optional region filtering.

commands.name: hex-dump
commands.description: Dump a hex view of a ROM file at a specific offset.

commands.name: message-source-sync
commands.description: Dry-run or CAS-publish a complete canonical expanded-message bundle and deterministic no-org Asar include

commands.name: oracle-menu-index
commands.description: Scan Oracle menu ASM for incbin assets, draw routines, and menu_offset component tables.

commands.name: oracle-menu-set-offset
commands.description: Update a single menu_offset(row,col) entry in a component table. Dry-run by default; use --write to apply.

commands.name: oracle-menu-validate
commands.description: Validate Oracle menu bins and component tables; exits non-zero on errors.

commands.name: oracle-smoke-check
commands.description: Single-shot Oracle ROM smoke check covering D4 Zora Temple (water system), D6 Goron Mines (minecart rooms 0xA8/0xB8/0xD8/0xDA), and D3 Kalyxo Castle (prison room 0x32 collision readiness). Structural failures always exit non-zero; readiness gaps are informational unless --strict-readiness is set.

commands.name: overworld-allocation
commands.description: Map overworld area IDs $00-$BF (used/free, parent, size, map pointer, per-area table coverage) and check whether TailMapExpansion.asm is safe for this ROM.

commands.name: overworld-doctor
commands.description: Diagnose overworld data: map pointer issues, tile16 layout, and ZSCustomOverworld feature detection.

commands.name: overworld-validate
commands.description: Validate map32 pointer tables and decompression for all overworld maps. Detects corruption and pointer issues.

commands.name: project-bundle-pack
commands.description: Pack a .yazeproj bundle directory into a .zip archive for cross-platform sharing (Windows/macOS/Linux). Preserves the bundle root folder name inside the archive.

commands.name: project-bundle-unpack
commands.description: Unpack a .zip archive into a .yazeproj bundle directory. Enforces path traversal safety (rejects .. and absolute-path entries).

commands.name: project-bundle-verify
commands.description: Verify the structural integrity and portability of a .yaze project file or .yazeproj bundle directory. Checks path existence, config parsing, reference sanity, and ROM accessibility.

commands.name: rom-compare
commands.description: Compare a target ROM against a baseline to identify differences, detect corruption, and verify data integrity with optional region filtering and smart diffing.

commands.name: rom-doctor
commands.description: Diagnose ROM file integrity including checksums, header validation, expansion status, and deep corruption scans.

commands.name: sprite-doctor
commands.description: Validate sprite tables, graphics pointers, and common issues.

commands.name: test-list
commands.description: List available ctest labels, test counts, and requirements for each test suite.

commands.name: test-run
commands.description: Run ctest with specified label/preset and produce structured output. Supports regex filtering of tests.

commands.name: test-status
commands.description: Show current test configuration including ROM path, active preset, and which test suites are enabled.

commands.name: tools-extract-golden
commands.description: Extract comprehensive golden data for testing

commands.name: tools-harness-state
commands.description: Generate WRAM state for test harnesses
